behaviors.description: Search competing default, named and user catalogues with explicit selectors.
behaviors.preconditions: Disposable namespace with independent A/B AppStream fixtures and distinct remote names in every installation.
behaviors.expected: Each selector returns only its own exact application/branch/remote rows for the matching independent term; opposite terms yield no matches and nothing is installed.

mappings.rationale: Competing catalogues, distinct remote names and positive/negative search terms distinguish every installation selector.

surface_assertions.rationale: Only user-catalogue rows appear despite matching entries in the system store.
Only default-system rows appear despite competing named/user catalogues.
The named store exposes independent B search terms and excludes default/user A terms.
